Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Jan Baptist van Rensselaer’s father (Kiliaen van Rensselaer) was from Belgium based on a single Wikipedia snippet mentioning “Hasselt, Belgium,” without verifying or disambiguating the place name. There are two cities named Hasselt; authoritative sources (and Kiliaen’s own page) indicate Hasselt, Overijssel, Netherlands. Failing to cross-check and relying on one ambiguous source led to the wrong country.
